# LahtiES

> Lahti Entrepreneurship Society - Crazy until proven right.

LahtiES is home to passionate, ambitious individuals who believe in the power of innovation and learning from every experience.
We are based in the Isku Center in Lahti, Finland. We are a non-profit student organization founded in 2024.

## Pages

- [About](https://lahties.com/about) - Displays information about the current board composition and officers.
- [Events](https://lahties.com/events) - Displays a Luma iframe with all upcoming events.
- [Projects](https://lahties.com/projects) - Contains all the former and present projects that LahtiES has.
- [News](https://lahties.com/news) - News related to LahtiES (like event recaps, board changes etc.).
